Students and youth leaders march to the U.S. Embassy in Manila during the “March for Peace,” led by Youth for Justice and Peace on Tuesday, April 28.

The protest marks the 12th anniversary of the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA), with calls to scrap military treaties and end the U.S.-Israel war against Iran. 

📸: John Louie Abrina/MB

data.text:
Actually, there are many great places in Manila that TREASURE can visit—such as Intramuros, Rizal Park, Fort Santiago, and the National Museum of the Philippines, as well as Binondo Chinatown for a food trip and culture experience. 

The main challenge, though, is the intense heat lately (especially since it didn’t rain during their stay—which is quite unusual 😅), along with the heavy traffic na super OA and their tight schedule. Hopefully, on their next concert visit, they’ll have at least one extra day so they can fully explore and enjoy Manila. 🥹🫶
